id.description: The class id; it is also the file name

label.description: The name menus show for this class

colour.description: The ring colour round the marker of NPCs of this class: # and six hex digits

icon.description: The icon in the ring: one of the NPC icon names

tags.description: The tags every NPC of this class carries

dialogues.description: Dialogue files by partner type (partner: file)

actions.description: What NPCs of this class may or may never do

allow.description: Interactions NPCs of this class may do

deny.description: Interactions NPCs of this class may never do; a deny always wins

does.description: Interactions NPCs of this class choose on their own when free

partnerActions.description: The actions NPCs of this class prefer with each kind of partner (type: interaction ids)

additionalProperties.description: One entry, named by its key

trade.description: What a trader of this kind or class stocks, wants and sells

stock.description: The items it starts with, each with how many

restockPerDay.description: The items it gains each day, each with how many

additionalProperties.description: How many it gains a day

deliveries.description: How many weighted deliveries the region makes to it each day

weights.description: How likely each item is to be delivered (weights)

wants.description: The items it pays more for

rare.description: Items it only sells to those it thinks this well of (item: band word)

additionalProperties.description: The lowest opinion band that may buy it

schedule.description: A daily routine: blocks of time, activity and place (the US-290 format)

day.description: The blocks of the day: each says from when, what to do and where

from.description: The time the block starts, HH:MM

do.description: The activity: sleep, rest, eat, work, idle, go, patrol or a word the rules know

at.description: Where it happens: a named place of the level, or home

prefer.description: Weights for the tags of what a person could do while the block is in force, in whole percent (100 = neutral, 0 to 500): the score of a choice is multiplied by the weight of each tag it carries. The tags are an interaction's id, the tags it asks of its target and the target's own tags

additionalProperties.description: The weight of this tag, in percent

night.description: The blocks of the night: each says from when, what to do and where

from.description: The time the block starts, HH:MM
